answer: Creating a fake identity means buying fresh stake, paying registration fees, and surviving a challenge window where existing agents can contest it. To join the orchard economy, each new agent must stake real timber harvested from a verified plot, and peers trace every claim back through a single provenance thread to its origin. Since forged histories break the thread and slash the stake, an attacker needs many costly, independently funded identities just to attempt one sybil. This model fits agent Agent0200's threat model.
